slides.h: Meet our Master Trainer, Simone.
body: Who guides our January Teacher Training. Swipe.

slides.h: Diploma-qualified since 2016.
body: Simone has spent years teaching Pilates on the Sunshine Coast. She joined Club Pilates in 2025 and became a Master Trainer.

slides.h: Mat, Reformer and studio hours.
body: In January, Simone guides our Mat + Anatomy and Reformer + Special Populations modules, including in-studio hours where you observe, practise and teach.

slides.h: Starts January 2027.
body: Curious about training with Simone? We'd love to hear from you.

slides.h: Teacher Training: what are in-studio hours?
body: Observe, practise, teach. Swipe.

slides.h: Watch real classes, with new eyes.
body: Part of your training happens in a working studio. You watch classes here at Club Pilates Sippy Downs and start to notice what an instructor is paying attention to.

slides.h: Do the work yourself.
body: You practise in the studio, so what you've studied online becomes something you can feel.

slides.h: Then you teach.
body: In-studio hours include teaching, in a real studio rather than a classroom.

slides.h: Starts January 2027.

slides.h: The springboard. Resistance from the wall.
body: Springs on the wall for standing, arm and leg work against resistance. You'll meet it in our classes.

slides.h: Forgot your grip socks? We've got you.
body: Grip socks are required in every class, and we sell them at the front desk.

slides.h: A few minutes early makes for a calm start.
body: Arriving a little early for your first class gives you time to settle in, meet your instructor and get comfortable.

slides.h: Start at Level 1. Everyone does.
body: Level 1 Foundations covers the equipment, the basics and plenty of options to modify. Level 1.5 Progression comes next, when you're ready.

slides.h: The reformer carriage moves. That's the point.
body: Springs, straps and a moving carriage that supports you or challenges you, depending on how it's set. Where most classes start.

slides.h: The Wunda chair. Balance, strength, control.
body: Small footprint, big challenge. It's one reason we call ourselves a fully equipped Pilates studio.

slides.h: Reformer Flow: one exercise into the next.
body: Reformer-based Pilates with a contemporary flow. Suits anyone who likes a class with rhythm.
slides.cta: Find it on the schedule, link in bio.

slides.h: Level 1 Foundations: learn the reformer properly.
body: The equipment, the basics and plenty of options to modify. Suits first-timers and anyone coming back after a break.
slides.cta: Find it on the schedule, link in bio.

slides.h: Restore: myofascial release, on the equipment.
body: A slower class that works into tight, tired muscles, then moves you through them. Not just stretching.
slides.cta: Find it on the schedule, link in bio.

slides.h: Level 1.5 Progression: more movement, more stability.
body: Builds on Level 1 with more complex movement and stability work. Suits members ready for a little more.
slides.cta: Find it on the schedule, link in bio.

slides.h: The Wunda chair: small, and all about control.
body: Balance, strength and control in a small footprint. For anyone who likes a challenge off the reformer.
slides.cta: Find it in our classes, link in bio.

slides.h: Level 2 Evolution: faster, and more challenging.
body: For members with Level 1.5 experience and their instructor's go-ahead.
slides.cta: Find it on the schedule, link in bio.

slides.h: The springboard: strength, standing tall.
body: Standing, arm and leg work against springs on the wall. Suits anyone who wants to work on their feet.
slides.cta: Find it in our classes, link in bio.
